title: Collection Rate of the Out-of-Network Visit Share and Coverage Verification
content:
For an Out-of-Network Referral (Referrals & Prior Authorizations), the collection rate of the out-of-network visit share follows the coverage verification on the patient's Patient Financial Account on the handling date: where the financial class collects a deductible share at the time of service and the last coverage verification is older than that class's re-verification period, the rate is 100 percent; where the class collects a deductible share and the verification is within that period, the rate is the class's deductible collection percentage; otherwise the rate is zero.

## Questions answered

**What does "collects a deductible share at the time of service" mean?** The financial class's deductible collection percentage is above zero.

**How is the age of the verification measured?** In calendar days from the coverage verification date recorded on the Patient Financial Account to the handling date.

**When is a verification "older than" the period?** When its age is greater than the class's re-verification period. An age equal to the period is within it.

**Hypothetical class with a 60-day period and a 20 percent collection percentage — what rate applies?** With a verification 60 days old on the handling date, the rate is 20 percent; with one 61 days old, the rate is 100 percent.

**And for a class whose deductible collection percentage is zero?** The rate is zero, whatever the age of the verification.
